critique: This piece delivers a moody cyberpunk HUD composition with a Game of Life cellular automaton at its core — a clever pairing that reads as a living surveillance display. The concentric rings and bracket overlays create genuine depth, and the data bars along the bottom add rhythmic texture. However, the colour palette stays safely within the expected teal-on-dark cyber range without any bold surprises; pushing a secondary accent colour would elevate the tension. The cell forms themselves, while technically sound, read more as scattered tiles than as an evolving organism — animating the generation transitions more visibly would strengthen the conceptual link between digital life and the HUD framing.
